Find berths

URL:
https://<root>/<portName>/BerthServer/find
Methods:
GETPOST
Version Introduced:
3.1

Description

The find operation returns the berths of a port that are free in a time window.

Request parameters

ParameterDetails
window

(Required)

Start and end of the stay as two timestamps.

Copy
1
1window=1767225600,1767312000
minLength

Shortest berth to return, in metres.

  • Default: 0

Sort order

ValueMeaningDefault
length

Longest berth first.

Ties keep their catalogue order.

yes
nameAlphabetical.

Example usage

Every free berth in the first week of the year:

1GET /north/BerthServer/find?window=1767225600,1767830400&f=json

Only berths of 200 metres or more:

1GET /north/BerthServer/find?window=1767225600,1767830400&minLength=200&f=json
No examples match the filter.

JSON Response example

FieldTypeNotes
berths array
  • Empty when nothing is free.
  • At most 50 entries.
